hints.title: Step Score Equivalence
hints.text: Jumping from index i to j with score (j - i) * nums[i] is identical to taking single unit steps and accumulating nums[i] for each step.

hints.title: Monotonic Dominance
hints.text: Whenever you encounter a larger value nums[j] > nums[i], it is always strictly superior to jump directly to j and use nums[j] for subsequent unit steps.

hints.title: Prefix Maximum Accumulation
hints.text: The total maximum score equals the sum of the maximum value seen so far across all indices from 0 up to n - 2.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating running maximums across n - 1 positions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible jump sequence combinations requires exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory without requiring DP arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the jump score formula telescopes into unit steps governed by running prefix maximums.
